tasks.short: Direct remote-sensing hardware and software implementation and enhancement

steps.what: Review actual implementation tasks, operating incidents, dependencies and test status
inputs: existing engineer-maintained project tasks and incidents
actual system test and operating-status records
outputs: scientist-checked activity status and unresolved dependencies

steps.what: Determine priorities and technical direction for implementation, operation or enhancement from actual requirements and evidence
inputs: scientist-checked activity status and unresolved dependencies
actual sensing/application requirements and resource constraints
outputs: scientist's activity priorities and technical direction

steps.what: Direct the responsible hardware/software personnel, resolve actual coordination questions and agree the next work
inputs: scientist's activity priorities and technical direction
responsible personnel's actual constraints and questions
outputs: actual coordinated implementation/operation decisions and responsibilities

steps.what: Update and finish checking the actual activity plan with agreed work, owners and unresolved issues
inputs: actual coordinated implementation/operation decisions and responsibilities
existing engineer-maintained project tasks and incidents

steps.what: Commit the checked plan update in the same project record
inputs: complete checked activity-plan update

tasks.design: Configure a native activity view in {PROJECT} linking existing task, incident and test records from {OTHER}. The scientist checks actual status, directs personnel and updates the real plan; the view neither deploys software nor controls sensing hardware.
tasks.previous_blocker: Related implementation and operating-status sources can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project views and existing record links can consolidate actual status.
tasks.still_hard: Choose priorities across technical dependencies and operational constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve technical tradeoffs and coordinate responsible specialists.

ambition.what: Improve activity visibility without autonomous technical direction.

reach.task: Maintain actual task and test status and perform the directed work
reach.learn: Actual agreed priorities and unresolved technical dependencies

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project views can link existing task, incident and test records; scientific priorities and technical coordination remain human decisions.

assumptions: OTHER is the existing sensing-system test/operations record. Engineers already produce project and test status as part of their work; no new free structured status capture is assumed. Missing updates remain explicit and need actual follow-up.

Native project configuration first. Scientist's plan update is separate from meetings and its commit. Actual engineering implementation and release authorization are not silently performed by the dashboard.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 5 minus 1 extra source-status reconciliation and 0.5 view upkeep gives 3.5 net. Same-system plan commit is 1% fully retained.
unknowns: Existing status quality and actual navigation/reconciliation burden
research_questions: Does a native activity view reduce navigation after counting missing-status reconciliation?

incremental.description: Reconcile missing or inconsistent source-status links

approvals.approved_version: complete actual plan update checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if source status or existing view is insufficient; cautious range below provisional 3.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain current remote-sensing knowledge through literature and meetings

steps.what: Find current remote-sensing literature and relevant meeting or seminar material using actual topic criteria
inputs: scientist's actual learning topics
actual bibliographic catalogue and meeting listings
outputs: scientist-checked relevant source and event records

steps.what: Read actual current literature and assess methods, validation data and limitations
inputs: scientist-checked relevant source and event records
actual full-text literature

steps.what: Attend actual meetings or seminars and engage with the presented developments and questions
inputs: scientist-checked relevant source and event records
actual presentations and discussion
outputs: actual meeting/seminar learning and professional exchange

tasks.design: Configure saved topic searches in {OTHER}, the existing bibliographic/event catalogue. The scientist checks records and reads original work or attends the actual event; no generated summary replaces learning or source verification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly rebuilding topic searches can add discovery effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches can reuse topic criteria against actual source records.
tasks.still_hard: Judge whether a reported remote-sensing advance generalizes beyond its validation setting.
tasks.human_edge: Critically assess methods and ask useful questions.

ambition.what: Reduce discovery mechanics while retaining actual learning.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bibliographic catalogues support saved searches; reading validation methods and participating in seminars remain scientific learning work.

assumptions: Catalogue publishers and event organizers produce actual records. Scientist supplies topic criteria; no invented article, URL or seminar. Native saved searches are read-only, not a hidden notification send.
No separate bibliography report or learning log is established by the statement. Any actual record must be mapped separately; literature reading and meetings are not replaced by abstracts.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 4 minus 0.5 search upkeep gives 3.5 net. If saved searches already suffice, no new saving.
unknowns: Actual discovery burden and current search setup
research_questions: Can saved topic queries reduce repeated search setup without losing relevant methods or validation papers?

already_counted.description: Check actual retrieved source and event records

incremental.description: Maintain topic queries and inspect missed relevant sources

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if searches already configured; cautious range below provisional 3.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research applications and enhancements of remote-sensing technology

steps.what: Define the actual research question, experimental comparison and validation criteria
inputs: actual application or technology question
available sensing data and reference observations
outputs: scientist-defined research design and validation plan

steps.what: Select and check actual scenes, sensor metadata and reference observations for the defined comparison
inputs: scientist-defined research design and validation plan
actual authorized scenes and sensor metadata
actual reference observations
outputs: scientist-checked scene/reference set and processing requirements

steps.what: Set up and check repeated scene-processing runs using the specified geospatial operations and explicit parameters
inputs: scientist-checked scene/reference set and processing requirements
scientist-defined research design and validation plan
existing verified geospatial operations
outputs: traceable processed scene outputs and actual processing exceptions

steps.what: Compare actual outputs with reference observations, investigate errors and interpret whether the application or enhancement works
inputs: traceable processed scene outputs and actual processing exceptions
scientist-checked scene/reference set and processing requirements
scientist-defined research design and validation plan
outputs: scientist's validated comparison findings and research limitations

steps.what: Write and check the research record with actual methods, parameters, findings and validation limits
inputs: scientist's validated comparison findings and research limitations
traceable processed scene outputs and actual processing exceptions
scientist-defined research design and validation plan

steps.what: Save the checked research record in the existing project document store
inputs: complete checked remote-sensing research record

tasks.design: Configure a rerunnable native processing graph in {OTHER}, the existing geospatial analysis system, on checked sources in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The scientist supplies scene selection and parameters, checks run outputs and interprets the actual validation results in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly setting up equivalent processing operations for each scene can duplicate human run preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native batch graphs can reuse verified operations and explicit parameter sets.
tasks.still_hard: Design a valid comparison and understand spatial, temporal and sensor-related errors.
tasks.human_edge: Judge applicability and distinguish processing artifacts from research findings.

ambition.what: Repeat the defined comparison on genuinely new validated scene sets.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: geospatial systems can run reusable processing graphs over selected scenes; experimental design, source quality and validation interpretation remain scientific work.

assumptions: Actual sensor data providers and reference collection produce inputs before the research; s2 counts source selection and quality checking. Scientist produces explicit research/processing requirements; no model guesses sensor calibration or reference labels.

Native batch configuration first, no model or autonomous research agent. The 20% step is today's human repeated run setup and output handling, not pixel-computation runtime. New pipeline configuration/maintenance is deducted separately.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 10 minus 2 processing-graph upkeep gives 8 net. Existing equivalent batch graphs receive no saving; actual interpretation and 1% save remain.
unknowns: Existing graph reuse, manual run setup and source-data consistency
research_questions: Does a reusable graph reduce human run setup after counting parameter review, exceptions and pipeline upkeep?

already_counted.description: Check run setup and actual processing exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain and regression-check the reusable processing graph

approvals.approved_version: complete actual research record checked at end of s5; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if batch processing already native or exceptions erase gains; cautious range below provisional 8% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend remote-sensing hardware or software acquisitions

steps.what: Define actual sensing/application needs, compatibility constraints and acquisition criteria
inputs: actual sensing/application requirements
existing hardware/software environment and acquisition constraints
outputs: scientist-defined acquisition criteria and unresolved requirements

steps.what: Find and verify actual candidate specifications, support terms and available evaluation evidence
inputs: scientist-defined acquisition criteria and unresolved requirements
actual approved supplier catalogues and candidate documentation
outputs: source-checked candidate facts and evidence gaps

steps.what: Evaluate actual candidates against scientific performance, integration and practical acquisition constraints
inputs: source-checked candidate facts and evidence gaps
scientist-defined acquisition criteria and unresolved requirements
actual available benchmark findings
outputs: scientist's acquisition judgement with tradeoffs and missing evidence

steps.what: Write and finish checking the actual acquisition recommendation, supporting facts, limitations and intended internal recipient
inputs: scientist's acquisition judgement with tradeoffs and missing evidence
source-checked candidate facts and evidence gaps
actual acquisition decision-owner details
outputs: complete checked acquisition recommendation and internal recipient

steps.what: Send the exact checked recommendation to the internal acquisition decision owner
inputs: complete checked acquisition recommendation and internal recipient
outputs: actual recommendation delivered for an acquisition decision

tasks.design: Configure native candidate filters in {OTHER}, the existing approved supplier/catalogue source. The scientist verifies actual specifications, evaluates fit and writes the recommendation in {DOCS}, checking its final version before an internal {EMAIL} send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Candidate documentation can require repeated search and navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue filters can narrow actual candidate sources against explicit criteria.
tasks.still_hard: Judge performance claims, integration costs and missing benchmark evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Recommend an appropriate acquisition with honest tradeoffs.

ambition.what: Reduce source navigation without automated purchasing or ranking.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: acquisition recommendations use actual specifications and evaluation evidence; native catalogue filters aid discovery but do not establish scientific suitability.

assumptions: Supplier documentation and actual available benchmarks produce candidate facts; scientist defines criteria and evaluates them. Missing trials or costs remain explicit, not inferred from product descriptions.
Native filters first. No invented product, price, URL or customer case. This task recommends only; no purchase order, deployment or approval of expenditure is hidden in the send.

Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 3 minus 0.5 filter/source upkeep gives 2.5 net. Recommendation authorship and the 1% internal send remain fully retained; final checking stays inside authoring.
unknowns: Actual candidate evidence, catalogue coverage and source navigation effort
research_questions: Can native filters reduce navigation while preserving verification of compatibility, support and scientific performance claims?

incremental.description: Maintain criteria filters and source-document links

approvals.approved_version: complete acquisition recommendation and internal recipient checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if source navigation already efficient; cautious range below provisional 2.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Engineers produce actual status; data providers supply scenes; acquisition owners decide expenditure.
skills_to_grow: Keep scene and validation provenance traceable
Reuse native processing graphs without counting compute runtime as labor
Verify actual candidate and project-status sources
role.ambitious_version: Reduce verified navigation and repeated processing setup while retaining scientific design, technical direction and acquisition judgement.
